deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics on it. It is the marbled-paper inside cover or pastedown of the bound volume. Its only content is archival:

- Pencil shelf-mark at the top left: "GAUß, HANDBUCH. 6".
- A printed library label reading "Auch als Mikroform vorhanden unter Sign.:" ("Also available as microform under shelf-mark:").
- Handwritten in ink on the label: "MF/Cod. Ms. Gauß Handb. 6".

This identifies the volume as Gauss's Handbuch 6 in the Niedersächsische Staats- und Universitätsbibliothek Göttingen (Cod. Ms. Gauß Handb. 6). It also records that a microfilm copy exists. None of this is in Gauss's hand; it consists of later library annotations. There are no derivations to reconstruct.
deep.surprise_reason: This is a binding cover with library shelf-mark labels only. It contains no mathematical content.
transcription_corrections: The pencil note reads 'GAUß, HANDBUCH. 6'. The 'GAUB' in the machine transcription is a misreading of 'GAUß', with ß rendered as B.
The 'MF' in 'MF/Cod. Ms. Gauß Handb. 6' is written as a superscript before the slash. The 'Ms.' is handwritten in a form resembling 'Ms.'.
